runtime_proof.continuous_10ms_service: FAIL: later UI event did not produce a stable framebuffer before timeout.
runtime_proof.four_block_trigger_budget: SUPERSEDED: the stall was caused by the missing recurring DSPI1 eDMA request, not ColdFire throughput.
runtime_proof.one_block_trigger_budget: PASS: NO, Trig 1 and later SMP events produced the expected stable UI transition.
runtime_proof.controller_lifecycle_probe: PASS: the shim can distinguish source-63 pending, native IFR63 clear on ISR entry, and CPU IPL below 5 after ISR completion.
runtime_proof.eight_block_lifecycle_budget: PASS: eight channel-30 and eight channel-42 linked transfers completed after one Trig-1 edge, followed by a stable SMP-page framebuffer.
runtime_proof.stall_resolution: Firmware clears DSPI1 SR.EOQF and waits at 0x40077D90. QEMU had serviced eDMA channel 15 only once, although ERQ remained enabled and the empty transmit FIFO should request another major loop. Re-arming DONE and pumping channel 15 at each modeled external-audio event regenerates EOQF through the native 16-word PUSHR transfer.
runtime_proof.native_sample_result: With continuous service disabled and no manual vector-191 injection, the Trig-1 edge reached stock renderer 0x4010A2E0 at block selector 3.

implementation.continuous_trace_compatibility: AR_MK2_MOCK_AUDIO_SERVICE=1 retains the prior continuous research behavior.
implementation.encoder_safety: The UART observer consumes the value following both 0x2n button and 0x3n encoder commands, preventing encoder deltas from being mistaken for pad commands.
implementation.interrupt_safety: A trigger request waits 10 Type-8 ticks for native trigger state, then remains pending until firmware clears IFR63; completion requires CPU IPL below 5 before another request is issued. The verified desktop budget is eight blocks.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_SUSTAINED_AUDIO_GATE
next_gate.objective: Measure and model the physical external-audio cadence, then determine whether sustained host playback can remain responsive without the bounded eight-block trigger budget.
